title: Hexo site configuration
description: The site's _config.yml. Hexo reads many more keys than these, so other keys are allowed; these are the ones an edit usually touches.

author.description: The name shown as the site's author in feeds and metadata.

description.description: One sentence about the site, for search results and feeds.

language.description: The site language as a tag such as en or fa-IR.

permalink.description: The address pattern for posts; the default is :year/:month/:day/:title/.

public_dir.description: The folder Hexo writes the built site to; public by default.

root.description: The path the site is served under, such as / for a domain or /docs/ for a project site.

source_dir.description: The folder that holds the content; source by default.

theme.description: The folder under themes/ whose layout the site uses.

timezone.description: The time zone post dates are read in, such as Europe/Berlin.

url.description: The address the site is served at, without a trailing slash.
